description: Use when you need each day's return of one stock split into market, sector and subsector factor returns and the residual (stock-specific) return. Not for raw total returns (use riskmodels_get_returns) or residual returns for many stocks (use riskmodels_get_residual_returns). Returns, from GET /returns-decomposition, the daily gross return and its additive components (decimal returns); include_lstar adds the residual series at each day's recommended hedge depth. End-of-day data, refreshed after each US market close. Price: $0.04 per call plus $0.01 per year of history beyond the first.

include_lstar.description: true adds the lstar level and lstar_residual_return arrays, e.g. true (default false)

market_factor_etf.description: ETF ticker used as the market factor, e.g. QQQ (default SPY)

threshold.description: Marginal explained-risk threshold for the hedge-depth rule, a fraction, e.g. 0.01 (default 0.01)

ticker.description: US stock ticker symbol, case-insensitive, e.g. AAPL

years.description: Calendar years of daily history, integer, e.g. 2 (default 1)

name: riskmodels_get_return_attribution
title: RiskModels Return Attribution (factor vs residual)
